origin.description: Rebuilds a precision matrix from partial correlations and partial variances.

arguments.name: pv
arguments.text: A partial variance for each variable.

origin.details: A negative partial variance raises an error. Off-diagonal entries are negated after scaling by the reciprocal square roots.
